entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes. It's VF886-042. I assume you can find it.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order from October 24th for the VeloFit Pro-Lite cycling shoes. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?
They don't work for me. They're giving me blisters on every ride.
I'm very sorry to hear that. That sounds incredibly uncomfortable. Is it a sizing issue, or perhaps something with how the cleats are positioned?
I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times. The shoes just don't fit right. I just want a refund.

I understand completely. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. Okay, I see here that the purchase was made 58 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window.

Absolutely. I can approve that refund for you right now. I also see you're one of our VIP members, and I want to apologize for the trouble you've had with these cycling shoes. As a courtesy, I've waived the return shipping fee and added a $15 credit to your account for your next purchase.
Whatever. Just send me the label. The credit is fine, I guess.
Of course. I've just emailed the pre-paid return label to you. Once we receive the shoes, we'll process your full refund. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can provide you with a better experience next time. Have a good day.
